title: data for ask.raise
description: Open a structured question for the owner. Shows in the owner-attention block at once.

lane.description: The lane that owns this record. Absent means the task's lane. s21: a step or ask of another lane on a shared task.

waiting_since.description: The age the ask carries when it replaces another (a migration splitting a composite ask keeps the original wait). Accepted only with origin "migrate-s21 …".
